metadata.title: Update Documentation
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Update flow documentation after implementing a new feature or making significant changes to existing workflows. Use when you need to ensure documentation is kept in sync with code changes.

specificActions: Review all code changes to identify if flows were affected
Use Documentation Scope Decision Tree to determine documentation type and scope
Create flow documentation if a new end-to-end workflow was introduced
Update existing flow documentation if the workflow was modified
Ensure documentation is clear, concise, and follows existing patterns
tools: codebase_search - Find related documentation to reference
write - Create or update documentation files
bestPractices: Documentation should be written for developers who are new to the codebase
Use examples to clarify complex concepts
Keep documentation up-to-date - don't let it drift from code
Use consistent terminology across all documentation
Use mermaid diagrams for visual representation
Link to related flows when relevant

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Review Code Changes
substeps.description: Review all code changes to identify documentation needs
actions: Review new files, modified services, new controllers
Read previous implementation step from memory.json
Identify what was implemented (files created, services added)

substeps.name: Determine Documentation Type and Scope
substeps.description: Use decision tree to determine what documentation is needed and at what level of detail
actions: Check if new end-to-end flow was introduced (e.g., webhook trigger → process → notification) → needs new flow documentation in ai/docs/flows/
Check if new component/service was added (e.g., new API client, new service manager) → needs component documentation in ai/docs/components/
Check if existing workflow was modified → needs flow documentation update
Check if configuration change (new settings, new environment variables) → update configuration documentation
Check if only minor enhancement (bug fix, small refactor, internal change) → minimal or no documentation needed (code comments sufficient)
Determine level of detail: Comprehensive (new feature/integration), Targeted (enhancement), or Minimal (small change)

substeps.name: Identify Existing Documentation
substeps.description: Search for related documentation that might need updates
actions: Search for related documentation using file_search in ai/docs/**/*.md
Use keywords: feature name, service names, API endpoints, workflow terms
List found documentation that might need updates
Review existing documentation patterns and style for consistency

substeps.name: Create or Update Documentation
substeps.description: Create new or update existing documentation based on determined type and scope
actions: For new workflows: Create new flow document in ai/docs/flows/{flow-name}.md
For new components: Create component document in ai/docs/components/{component-name}.md
For modified workflows: Update existing flow document
Comprehensive scope: Include overview, mermaid diagrams, component responsibilities, data flow, error handling, integration points
Targeted scope: Include what changed, updated diagram, integration with existing components
Minimal scope: Include brief description, updated configuration example
Use mermaid for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and architecture diagrams
Follow existing documentation structure and style
Link to related documentation

substeps.name: Review and Validate
actions: Ensure documentation is clear and accurate
Verify mermaid diagrams render correctly
Verify all links and references work
Ensure consistency with existing documentation style
Ensure terminology is consistent with project conventions

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Review changes → Determine type → Find existing docs → Create/update docs (if needed) → Validate

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Previous implementation step section in memory.json (what was implemented)
fields: Information Produced: Documentation type, Documentation path, Changes documented
Files Modified/Created: List of documentation files
